verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents a pre-built "ML in a Box" machine template that comes with the major ML frameworks and CUDA drivers preinstalled, so developers can skip environment assembly for general PyTorch/CUDA work. The template is chosen at machine creation alongside the OS. Beyond that one general-purpose image, the evidence shows no catalog of task-specific templates. User-made custom templates are a cloning feature, not pre-built templates. Missing for 10: evidenced vLLM and ComfyUI templates, a broader template catalog, explicit PyTorch naming, and independent hands-on corroboration of the ML in a Box template.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch from pre-built ML templates (PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM, ComfyUI) instead of assembling an environment from scratch

citations.quote: Choose "ML in a Box" template that comes preinstalled with all the major ML frameworks and CUDA® drivers.
